### Improved
- The switcher opens faster, because it no longer waits on slow system lookups for the frontmost app.
- If you grant or revoke Accessibility in System Settings while Wicher's Settings window is open, the Switchers pane now updates on its own.
- The app picker in Settings → Exceptions is more responsive: it filters as you type without lagging, and app icons load in the background.

### Fixed
- Pressing function keys, Home, End or Forward Delete in the switcher no longer types stray characters into the search field.
